feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: NPR's expanded coverage of U.S. and world politics, the latest news from Congress and the White House and elections.

entry.title: Press pool dispute escalates as White House cuts CNN from Air Force One travel
entry.summary: The White House has barred CNN from traveling on Air Force One this weekend. It's another chapter in President Trump's fight with the press, and it appears there will be no TV pool coverage today.

entry.title: Supreme Court rejects GOP-backed Missouri map, preserving key seat for Democrats
entry.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court rejected a Republican attempt at redistricting congressional seats in Missouri - possibly giving Democrats a boost in their effort to win the House in the midterm elections.

entry.title: Week in Politics: Trump faces Republican defections; U.S.-China summit; press feud
entry.summary: Some GOP candidates are stepping back from unpopular Trump administration policies. Meanwhile, a U.S.-China summit at the White House and tensions with the press corps.

entry.title: Battle for the Lehigh Valley: Can GOP hold its razor-thin margin?
entry.summary: Both parties target the Lehigh Valley for House control. While the GOP made inroads with Latinos, Dems argue Trump's immigration stance hurts them. Can Republicans hold this 1% margin swing seat?

entry.title: The U.S. has more thalidomide survivors than the government admits
entry.summary: In the 1950s and 1960s, doctors gave the drug thalidomide to pregnant patients without telling them — and without FDA approval. Now those patients' children want recognition.

entry.title: Supreme Court blocks Trump-backed Missouri congressional map
entry.summary: The ruling is a defeat for Republicans seeking to give their party an edge in the midterms for control of the House. It means voters will face a different map than the one used in the primaries.

entry.title: What did we learn from the Trump-Xi summit?
entry.summary: President Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping wrap up their two-day summit. What did we learn beyond the pageantry?

entry.title: Takeaways from the Trump-Xi state visit: Pageantry and pandas
entry.summary: The visit comes at an important time for both men.

entry.title: The Supreme Court revives a controversial data system for citizenship checks
entry.summary: The Supreme Court is allowing use of a data system that Trump officials overhauled. The system has erroneously flagged U.S. citizens and a lower court found it violated federal privacy protections.

entry.title: Trump and China's Xi discuss AI, trade and Iran war during state visit
entry.summary: U.S. President Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping met for the second time this year to much fanfare but little in the way of grand bargains.
